verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a stablecoin infrastructure provider, but nothing in the evidence documents an embeddable widget or API that lets end users buy stablecoins with cards or bank transfers inside a developer's product. Circle Mint is business-level USD↔USDC conversion for qualified businesses, not an end-user onramp. CPN covers cross-border fiat payouts (off-ramp direction). Paying gas with a credit card is an adjacent feature, not an onramp. None of these qualify.
